_README_Auth: Sprint-7 U5 — AddShopFlowDefaults registers JwtBearer kernel-wide so every module API inherits the auth scheme that Auth.Api signs with. DevSecret must match Auth.Api byte-for-byte.
_README_ControlPlane: Services connect through PgBouncer (6432) as the app role shopflow_app — the role shopflow-migrate creates (Postgres:AppRoleName) and the only entry in the PgBouncer userlist. The pre-finish-line value 'shopflow' never matched either, so PgBouncer auth would have failed; it was never caught because no service had booted+connected.
